statements.statement: The claim was denied under CO-197
The denial reason was that required prior authorization was not obtained
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture the rhythm during symptomatic events
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess for underlying ischemic triggers or arrhythmic burden
